title: Hermes
tagline: Hermes, an AI powered chatbot to interact with any Ethereum based chain.
description:
We know that the web3 ecosystem requires a steep learning curve. The is an issue since this hinders the people from transitioning into web3 from web3. To tackle this problem, we built an AI chatbot to interact with any chain in any form. The process is as simple as using chatGPT. One can swap, interact with contracts, send transaction etc using Hermes. The will help onboard more people on Web3.

**Links**
- [https://github.com/pratham1729/react-chatbot](https://github.com/pratham1729/react-chatbot)
how_its_made: We ran into many challenges while building this project. The first one was that the issuer node of Polygon ID was not setting up as per the documents. Metamask doesn't allow signing the transaction without broadcasting it, hindering us to send it to our backend and process it. The accuracy of GPT-4 was also an issue which we circumvented by creating tools and fitting the responses of GPT-4 into those tools.
